root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: h3NeighborRotations(cell, right, &rRotations, &rightNeighbor) == E_SUCCESS before `rightNeighbor` is compared
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the unchecked right-neighbor lookup, `cellToVertex()` must stop before `if (rightNeighbor < owner)` unless `h3NeighborRotations(cell, right, &rRotations, &rightNeighbor)` succeeds and initializes the `rightNeighbor` out-parameter.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original records `right_neighbor_error=5` at the exact lookup site and still reaches the protected compare on the same stack slot. The fixed original reaches the same lookup with `right_neighbor_error=5` but returns before the compare, and the closest source-grounded boundary witness that replaces only the two `INVALID_DIGIT` (`7`) cells at resolutions 11 and 12 with the nearest valid digit `6` reaches the protected compare with `right_neighbor_error=0`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: Original vulnerable case: violated (`right_neighbor_error=5`, compare executed). Original fixed case: guarded (`right_neighbor_error=5`, no compare event). Genuine witness case: `invalid_digits_11_12_to6_boundary` (`right_neighbor_error=0`, compare executed on fixed side).

nodes.state: At the sink branch, `cellToVertex()` reads the same stack `rightNeighbor` slot that the unchecked right-neighbor lookup had just passed as its out-parameter.

edges.relation: The exact stack slot passed by address as `&rightNeighbor` to the unchecked lookup is the same slot immediately read by the later `rightNeighbor < owner` branch.
